name: Astron Corporation Limited
summary: Astron Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a mineral sands mining and processing company in Australia, China, and internationally. The company operates through Donald Mineral Sands, China, and Senegal segments. It primarily focuses on zircon and titanium mineral sands. The company holds interests in the Donald mineral sands project located in Victoria, Australia; and the Niafarang mineral sands project located in Senegal. It is also involved in titanium based materials trading activities. The company is incorporated in 2011 and is based in Minyip, Australia. Astron Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of P.T Arafua Mining Limited.
